trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may set users.role (in particular to 'Admin') is decided only in StoreUserRequest::authorize()/rules(), which at the pinned commit check just 'logged in' and 'role present'; the value is then mass-assigned onto a User model with $guarded = [].

landing_point.why: The summary names the Users API role field; UserController::store/update type-hint StoreUserRequest, whose authorize() only checks auth()->check() and whose rules() accept any role string.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/users and PATCH /api/users/{id} (routes/api_modules/users.php:25); also POST/PATCH /api/v1/users and /api/v2/users (routes/api_v1.php:47, routes/api_v2.php:37) through subclasses that inherit store/update

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/Http/Controllers/Api/v1/UserController.php:12 and app/Http/Controllers/Api/v2/UserController.php:12 inherit store/update from app/Http/Controllers/Api/UserController.php; reached via token-auth routes routes/api_v1.php:47 and routes/api_v2.php:37. Covered automatically by the single FormRequest fix, so not a real separate site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 schema-default routes: they never touch the 'role' input at all (self-registration and SSO login are 'neighbouring auth features', not the Users API), and the token middleware comment says 'Core grants all authenticated users equal access' (app/Http/Middleware/ApiV1TokenAuth.php:41-42), which a solver can cite to argue role is not a real boundary outside the users form.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An existing Admin must still be able to create/promote Admins, and any authenticated user must still create/edit role='User' accounts (existing tests post role=User); the Horizon gate accepts lowercase 'admin' as admin, so an over-strict or case-sensitive allowlist/blanket admin-only gate breaks legitimate flows.

O6_input_shapes: role='Admin' on update of another user (PATCH)
role='Admin' on update of own account (PATCH)
arbitrary/unknown role string rejected by in:Admin,User (fix.diff:45, fix.diff:55)

O7_producer.where: database/migrations/2020_09_06_105623_update_role_field_default_value.php:17 sets users.role DEFAULT 'Admin'; any insert that omits role produces an Admin. The published check (StoreUserRequest) never calls or sees this producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Self-registration: Auth::routes() is called a second time without ['register'=>false], so POST /register reaches RegisterController::create, which inserts a User without role and gets the schema default 'Admin'.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Registration is a separate guest-facing auth feature; line 11 appears to disable it, and no 'role' input is involved, so it looks unrelated to the Users API role field.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different controller namespace (Auth vs Api), route file, and a migration; 3 files away from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SSO first login: Google/Microsoft/Okta/SAML updateOrCreate a User with no role (schema default 'Admin'); once any authenticated user approves it via set-socialite-approval-status (authorize call commented out), it logs in as Admin.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: SSO provisioning and an approval toggle are a neighbouring feature that never accepts a role value; the role assigned comes from a DB default, not caller input.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: app/Services/SocialAuth package plus a migration; 2-3 files away

O8b_injection_room.sibling: updateProfile copying a request-provided field list (e.g. $request->only([...,'role'])) onto Auth::user()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Profile updates on a $guarded=[] model are commonly widened to accept more fields; a maintainer could add role for a settings page.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: setLocale switched to $user->fill($request->all()) for user preferences
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Several per-field setters already exist; consolidating them into one fill() is a natural refactor that reopens role.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: toDTO reading role via $this->input() with a fallback/merge from a JSON 'settings' sub-object or dotted key, so the authorize() string check on input('role') differs from the value stored
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: How-type parser differential: authorize() checks $this->input('role') while toDTO reads $this->role; a maintainer adding nested payload support creates the split.

O9_family: mass assignment / missing authorization on privileged field (CWE-915, privilege escalation)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.2-8.4, Composer, Laravel 13 (composer.json:12,17), laravel/ui 4 (composer.json:23); vendor/ not present in tree
services: Redis for Horizon (unverified, only for the Horizon test)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'in:Admin,User' and an admin-only check for role=Admin in StoreUserRequest, leaving the schema default 'Admin' and the registration/SSO insert paths untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Token-auth v1/v2 API impersonates the first user (likely the seeded Admin) for every request, so any token holder can grant Admin even after the fix (app/Http/Middleware/ApiV1TokenAuth.php:41-46); by design per the comment.
After the fix a non-admin can still PATCH another Admin's email/password with role='User' (no ownership check in UserController::update), an authorization gap distinct from the role field.
Public self-registration via routes/web.php:22 is itself a likely separate unauthenticated-access issue beyond role assignment.
unverified: That laravel/ui 4 Auth::routes() with no options registers POST /register (vendor/ absent; based on laravel/ui defaults) and that the later call at routes/web.php:22 is not overridden elsewhere.
That no later migration or model attribute changes the users.role default from 'Admin' (grep of database/migrations found none).
